note: Screenshots of the real Aspen Plus V15 GUI with the baseline model opened through COM and run before capture. status 'captured' entries were opened and visually checked after saving.

captures.title: Main Flowsheet
captures.navigation_path: Simulation environment > Main Flowsheet tab (Zoom to fit)
captures.what_is_shown: The complete AmCraX flowsheet as drawn by Aspen Plus: PUMP, VAPORIZR, FEHE, HEATER, CRACKER, COOLER, PSA, BURNER, FLUEHX with streams FEED, S1-S7, H2PROD, TAILGAS, AIR, FLUE, STACK.
captures.why_it_matters: Documents the process topology that every reported Aspen result comes from, including the feed-effluent heat integration loop and tail-gas combustion.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Component specification
captures.what_is_shown: Component list NH3, H2, N2, H2O, O2 with their databank identities.
captures.why_it_matters: Defines the chemical species system; all mass and energy balances and the Gibbs equilibrium are restricted to these components.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Property method
captures.why_it_matters: The Peng-Robinson equation of state sets the fugacities used in the high-pressure cracking equilibrium and the enthalpies in every heat duty.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Feed stream input
captures.what_is_shown: FEED specification: pressure, vapour fraction, total flow and mole-fraction composition.
captures.why_it_matters: Fixes the basis of the whole simulation (refrigerated liquid ammonia with trace water), to which all KPIs are normalised.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: CRACKER (RGibbs) setup
captures.what_is_shown: RGibbs calculation option, reactor temperature and pressure specifications.
captures.why_it_matters: The cracker is modelled as an isothermal Gibbs-equilibrium reactor; temperature and pressure set the equilibrium NH3 conversion.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: CRACKER possible products
captures.what_is_shown: Products tab of the RGibbs block: option "Identify possible products" with NH3, H2, N2 and H2O listed (valid phase Mixed).
captures.why_it_matters: For an RGibbs reactor this is the reaction specification: equilibrium is computed over these species only (NH3, H2, N2, H2O; oxygen occurs only in H2O, so the water is effectively inert).
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: FEHE (HeatX) setup
captures.what_is_shown: HeatX setup: Shortcut model, countercurrent, Design mode, specification "Cold stream outlet temperature" with its value and minimum temperature approach.
captures.why_it_matters: The feed-effluent exchanger recovers reactor-effluent heat; its specification sets the hot-end approach and hence the external heater duty.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: PSA (Sep) split fractions
captures.what_is_shown: Specifications tab of the Sep block: component split fractions to outlet H2PROD (substream MIXED).
captures.why_it_matters: The PSA is a reduced-order material balance (H2 recovery, N2 slip), not a designed PSA; these fractions fix product and tail-gas flows.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: BURNER (RStoic) setup
captures.what_is_shown: Reactions tab of the RStoic burner: two fractional-conversion reactions (H2 + 0.5 O2 -> H2O; NH3 + 0.75 O2 -> 0.5 N2 + 1.5 H2O), fractional conversion 1 of the key component.
captures.why_it_matters: Tail-gas combustion supplies process heat; the stoichiometry determines flue-gas composition and the recoverable heat.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Stream results
captures.what_is_shown: Material stream table of the converged baseline: temperatures, pressures, flows and compositions.
captures.why_it_matters: Primary evidence of the converged Aspen solution from which the H2 production and conversion KPIs are extracted.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: CRACKER results
captures.what_is_shown: RGibbs results summary of the converged baseline: outlet temperature, outlet pressure, heat duty and net heat duty.
captures.why_it_matters: Shows the endothermic cracking duty that dominates the energy demand of the process.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: FEHE thermal results
captures.what_is_shown: HeatX thermal results: hot stream S5 -> S6 and cold stream S2 -> S3 inlet/outlet temperatures and pressures, and the exchanger heat duty.
captures.why_it_matters: Quantifies the heat recovered internally, the basis of the heat-integration benefit.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Sensitivity STEMP input
captures.navigation_path: Simulation > Model Analysis Tools > Sensitivity > STEMP > Input > Vary
captures.what_is_shown: Vary tab of STEMP: manipulated variable Block-Var CRACKER TEMP, equidistant from 350 to 800 C with an increment of 50 C.
captures.why_it_matters: Documents how the in-Aspen temperature sensitivity was defined.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Sensitivity STEMP results
captures.navigation_path: Simulation > Model Analysis Tools > Sensitivity > STEMP > Results
captures.what_is_shown: STEMP results summary table: for each varied CRACKER temperature the status and the tabulated NH3 conversion, H2 product flow, CRACKER duty and HEATER duty.
captures.why_it_matters: Aspen-native evidence of the trend of the tabulated variables with the varied reactor temperature.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window

captures.title: Run status
captures.what_is_shown: Run Status summary: "Calculations were completed normally", Aspen Plus version 41.0 (V15), run title, date and time of the run.
captures.why_it_matters: Convergence evidence: shows the baseline run completed and whether any warnings or errors were issued.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window
captures.redaction: The user-name and host-computer fields of the Run Status form are masked in this image (personal identifiers); nothing else was altered. The unmasked capture is kept locally in aspen/screenshots/originals/ and is excluded from version control.

captures.title: Calculator AIRCALC
captures.navigation_path: Simulation > Flowsheeting Options > Calculator > AIRCALC > Input
captures.what_is_shown: Define tab of Calculator AIRCALC: imported variables FH2 and FNH3 (TAILGAS component mole flows) and exported variable FAIR (AIR stream mole flow).
captures.why_it_matters: Shows how the specified burner excess air is maintained automatically when the tail-gas flow changes.
captures.capture_method: win32 PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of the Aspen Plus top-level window
